solubility_in_water.note: Soluble in water (about 6 g per 100 mL at 20 degC), giving an intense purple solution.

hazards.summary: Strong oxidiser; can ignite organic material. Harmful if swallowed and very toxic to aquatic life; stains skin and clothes.

reactions.note: Reduced to nearly colourless manganese(II) in acid, which makes it useful for titrations.

educational_notes: The purple colour is so intense that a single crystal colours litres of water.
